working_title: Return to sport after ACL reconstruction: an umbrella review
research_question: What is the review-level evidence on return to sport after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction in athletes and physically active adults?
rationale: Multiple systematic reviews address overlapping populations and outcomes, so an overlap-aware overview is needed before any new primary-study synthesis is considered.
objective: To summarize and critically appraise systematic-review evidence on return to sport after ACL reconstruction.
population: Athletes and physically active adults after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction
intervention_or_exposure: Anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction and postoperative rehabilitation
comparator: Alternative surgical or rehabilitation strategies where reported
primary_outcome: Return to preinjury level of sport
